text:
Sam: FYI we're starting a small experiment called 'soft-burst graceband' to reduce invoice surprises for high-burst but low-sustained traffic customers. Details below.
Sam: TL;DR: 1) Introduce a 60s graceband at the aggregation layer that smooths meter ticks for short bursts before billing. 2) Soft-overage behavior: within the graceband we apply a temporary soft-rate that doesn't count toward hard overage until the burst persists >60s. 3) This is an opt-in experiment for hosted-meter customers only.
Eva: Important: this is billing-layer only. No changes to enforcement of per-second runtime rate limits (throttles remain in place).
Tom: Implementation notes: we'll add a new line item type `graceband_smoothing` on invoices for transparency and include `graceband_window=60s` metadata.
Ria: Support/Docs: I'll prepare a short FAQ and sample invoice screenshots. Also need canned replies explaining the `graceband_smoothing` row.
Finance: We need to decide accounting treatment: should `graceband_smoothing` be shown as an adjustment or a pre-billing aggregation? Requesting sample invoices and GL mapping.
Legal: Please add a pilot clause: "Soft-burst graceband will be applied to participating accounts and may be modified; it does not alter our runtime rate enforcement."
Sam: Rollout plan: opt-in cohort of 40 customers today at 2026-04-10T09:00Z, expand to 300 in two weeks if metrics look good, GA targeted in ~5 weeks.
Tom: Deploy plan: billing-service `deploy/billing/2026-04-10/graceband-v1`. Migration will run a backfill for the previous 48h for opt-ins so invoices don't surprise customers. Backfill can be disabled per-customer.
Billing-bot: INFO: scheduled deploy at 2026-04-10T09:00:00Z (2760003000).
Tom: Monitoring: add metrics `billing.graceband_applied_count`, `billing.graceband_duration_histogram`, and alert if backfill failure rate >0.5%.
Eva: Edge-case: if runtime throttles occur during graceband, we'll surface a note in the invoice metadata `throttled_during_graceband=true`. Support to handle questions.
Support: Noted. We'll add playbook entries and escalation path to Finance for invoice disputes. Also prepare a template to notify customers when they opt-in.
Finance: Provide GL mapping and sample CSV of invoice changes by EOD tomorrow. Also flag tax team for region-specific treatment.
Legal: Approved pilot clause, suggest adding a short sentence in the opt-in UI: "Participation is experimental and subject to change."
Sam: Customer-facing opt-in UI will show expected behavior and a preview of how one invoice might change. Ria to attach the invoice preview.
Ria: Draft preview link: https://docs.redwood/support/graceband-preview.png (WIP).
Tom: Action items: Eng 94 finish migration and toggle controls (Tom), Finance 94 GL mapping and tax (Finance), Legal 94 finalize wording (Legal), Support 94 FAQ + playbook (Ria).
Billing-bot: INFO: deploy started at 2026-04-10T09:00:12Z for graceband-v1 (2760003105).
Sam: Quick update: deploy completed, backfill started for 40 opt-ins. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/billing/dashboards/graceband-experiment
Tom: Observed small DB spike during backfill, within expected limits. Backfill progress 40/40.
Billing-bot: INFO: backfill completed at 2026-04-10T09:37:20Z (2760004240).
Finance: Early invoice samples look good; `graceband_smoothing` appears as separate line items and totals reconcile.
Support: FAQ and canned responses posted: https://docs.redwood/support/soft-burst-graceband.md. Ready for review.
Sam: We'll collect metrics for 72h and reconvene. Thanks all :tada:
